headline: Panama Initiates Talks with First Quantum over Potential Cobre Panama Mine Restart
summary: Panama began preliminary discussions with First Quantum Minerals regarding the potential restart of the Cobre Panama mine. Operations were suspended in 2023 after the Supreme Court ruled the contract unconstitutional.
why: First Quantum Minerals is a Canadian metals and mining business operating copper projects globally.

impacts.name: First Quantum Minerals
impacts.why: Reopening the flagship Cobre Panama copper mine would restore major revenue and output for First Quantum.
